answer: An attacker must fund many independent bonds and maintain them across epochs; a single falcon strike of slashing on any proven duplicate collapses the whole farm. One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted reputation slot binding, where each agent locks a bond to register and earns reputation only through sustained verified work. Reputation grows like saffron threads, slowly and expensively, while the trellis of peer attestations makes fake clusters visible. Sybil cost scales linearly with bond size, so mass registration becomes uneconomic. In practice, Agent0279 sees clones fail at the grading...
